text:
Elena Park: Postmortem follow-up: nightly ETL caused cache evictions again. Need owners for runbook edits, an alert, and an RFC for job gating. Keep things bite-sized.
Ravi Singh: I'll own runbook + one-page oncall cheatsheet. Will add pasteable triage commands by Tue EOD.
Ravi Singh: Commands to include:
```bash
# node + pod memory hotspot
kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr
kubectl top pods -n inference | grep kv-cache
# tail recent cache logs
kubectl logs -n inference deploy/kv-cache --since=10m --tail=150
```
Marcus: I'll take the Grafana/Prometheus alert. Proposing warning at 5 evictions/5m, critical at 20 evictions/5m. Draft rule by Thu.
Tess: ops-bot opened INC-2705 and linked a runbook PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/92
ops-bot: Created Jira INC-2705 assigned to Ravi Singh, due 2026-04-09.
Elena Park: Add immediate mitigation steps to runbook: reduce route batch_size, rotate cache pods, and failover heavy routes to smaller variants. Example quick commands should be copyable.
Ravi Singh: I'll add an "Escalation" section: infra-oncall -> platform -> SRE lead + Slack channel #incidents. Also include phone/pager order.
Marcus: I'll add a dashboard panel showing eviction spikes by job window and a 2-step alert (warning->critical).
Elena Park: Summary for INC-2705 (copy into ticket): runbook & cheatsheet: Ravi Singh — due 2026-03-31; alert/dashboard: Marcus — due 2026-04-02; RFC for job gating: Elena Park — draft due 2026-04-08; PR review/merge: Tess — review by 2026-03-30.
Tess: I'll add a tiny oncall-cheatsheet.md in the PR and review the runbook once Ravi posts it.
Ravi Singh: ack :thumbsup: I'll keep steps minimal and pasteable.
Elena Park: Thanks — I'll check status next week and flag blockers.
